scope: Native optional diagnostic spool, bridge, consent, lifecycle preservation and push metadata compatibility

swiftHost.method: Actual MknoonCallDiagnostics.swift, actual token authority slice and actual spool XCTest source in a temporary SwiftPM harness with minimal Flutter type stubs. Eleven spool tests (including the shared wire fixture) plus two typed-invalidation causality tests.
swiftHost.boundary: Host core proof only; does not prove Flutter runtime channel registration, live PushKit delivery or actual iOS target linkage.

preservation: Native diagnostic drain is non-destructive until diagnostic ACK; canonical native journal ACK does not delete diagnostics.
Diagnostic sink failure cannot change canonical answer/audio admission.

Native failed consent write disables capture in memory; same-epoch same-request retry is permitted. Stale/equal-conflicting re-enable is refused. Durable opt-out cannot be claimed when persistence fails.
Native lookup exports only a diagnostic trace UUID, normalizes private compact/canonical handles, survives restart/ACK and refuses expired/disabled lookup.
Malformed optional push diagnostics are stripped before the unchanged strict call authority parser.
Closed Swift/Kotlin vocabularies match tool/call_diagnostics/schema_v1.json; Swift frontend parse and owned-path diff check pass.

causalRedGreen.before: One Android assertion failure: retry(true, same epoch) refused after sink failure.
causalRedGreen.after: Passes with desired consent separated from effective capture.

wireInterop.productionChange: Native context sanitizers map closed wire cause into internal reason; event schema unchanged.
wireInterop.androidBefore: Shared fixture sanitizer and actual native capability wrapper both fail before mapping.
wireInterop.swiftHostBefore: Shared fixture fails for both attempt and authority contexts before mapping.
wireInterop.after: All focused tests pass; trace/request/operation/parent UUIDs and cause are preserved.
wireInterop.iosWrapperBoundary: Actual iOS native wrapper test is added to RunnerTests and fixture bundled; source parses, but it is not part of the host-stub execution.
